statement: ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.mul f g = KdVPlan.mul g f
proof:
intro f g
funext k
unfold KdVPlan.mul
calc
  (∑' j : ℤ, f j*g (k-j)) = ∑' j : ℤ, g (k-j)*f (k-(k-j)) := by
    apply tsum_congr
    intro j
    simp only [sub_sub_cancel]
    exact mul_comm _ _
  _ = ∑' j : ℤ, g j*f (k-j) := (Equiv.subLeft k).tsum_eq _
